theorems.name: Submission.rpn_pe_inv_norm_pow_ball
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → IntegrableOn (fun t : Eucl (m + 1) => (‖t‖ ^ m)⁻¹) (ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) ρ) ∧ ∫ t in ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) ρ, (‖t‖ ^ m)⁻¹ = ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (volume (ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) 1)).toReal * ρ
